_about: The author's answers to the 'Needs your call' items in DECISIONS.md. Hand-editable. The reference page and DECISIONS.md show these as decided; tools/migration/decisions.mjs never overwrites this file.

call-after-letter.answer: Keep it off: letter triggers don't fire right after a letter (fire_after_letters = false).

call-subscript-commands.answer: Single letter or Greek letter only; log2 stays log2 (type log_2).

call-castel-text-envs.answer: Yes, as Tab-only at the start of a line in .tex: beg, enum, item, ali (text.lua).
